svg.title: The afternoon wall
svg.desc: No roof at all: a thick, porous west-end screen casts a long late-day shadow.. Bus stop concept with perspective and accessible site plan.
svg.text: No roof at all: a thick, porous west-end screen casts a long late-day shadow.
Air passes through; no moving parts.
KEEP CLEAR · continuous 1.8 m walking route
A robust, low-upkeep low-sun barrier, but protection depends on sun direction and offers no rain shelter.
